page.overview:
What is Universe?

The universe is a macrocosmic trinity comprising three fundamental realms of existence: the Physical World, the Astral World, and the Ideal World. Following the Great Wave of the Astral World, the universe has returned to an ancient state whereby the physical and astral realms are largely intermingled in a single realm known as Fantasia.
